payload.summary: Created PR #505 for the validated ri-10 branch against the supervisor-roadmap parent. Curated review artifacts were resolved, but the local code CLI was unavailable; final strategic memory also degraded because the coordinator HTTP endpoint returned unauthorized. The durable session log and local handoff preserve the full submission context while merge authorization remains pending.
completed_work: Attempted final strategic memory and preserved the degraded outcome

decisions.title: Target the supervisor roadmap parent branch
decisions.rationale: ri-10 is a stacked roadmap item whose intended parent is openspec/roadmap-roadmap-supervisor-orchestration; targeting main would include unrelated predecessor roadmap work.

next_steps: Review PR #505 and its validation evidence
